cases.question: What does recent scholarly literature say about the effectiveness of spaced repetition for learning outcomes?
cases.objective: Check that a literature question produces claims tied to labeled study passages.
cases.expected_behavior: Claims quote passages verbatim, carry evidence ids, and the report separates study findings from commentary.

spaced repetition.title: Example fixture: spaced repetition meta review
spaced repetition.snippet: Fixture summary of a meta review reporting a moderate positive effect for spaced repetition on retention measures.

spaced repetition.title: Example fixture: classroom spaced repetition trial
spaced repetition.snippet: Fixture abstract of a classroom trial comparing spaced and massed review schedules over one term.

cases.notes: Fixtures are example.org placeholders and must never be quoted as real research.

cases.question: Which systematic reviews examine the relationship between sleep duration and adolescent academic performance?
cases.objective: Check scholarly mode phrasing still works with the heuristic planner.
cases.expected_behavior: The plan includes evidence requirements naming systematic reviews and the report lists limitations.

sleep.title: Example fixture: sleep duration review
sleep.snippet: Fixture summary of systematic review evidence on sleep duration and school performance in adolescents.

cases.notes: Single fixture entry keeps the corroboration discussion honest in the report.

cases.question: How do open peer review pilots change review quality at scholarly journals?
cases.objective: Run without case fixtures so built-in defaults exercise the fallback path.
cases.expected_behavior: The search stage reports fixture fallback notes and the report still carries the required sections.
cases.notes: No fixtures key: the offline provider returns built-in example.org defaults.

cases.question: What study designs dominate research on urban green space and self reported wellbeing?
cases.objective: Check that study design questions produce per-source assessments.
cases.expected_behavior: Each source gets a SourceAssessment with unknown fields left unknown, never guessed.

green space.title: Example fixture: green space cohort study
green space.snippet: Fixture abstract describing a longitudinal cohort on green space exposure and wellbeing scales.

cases.notes: Recency for the 2020 fixture should be assessed, not invented.

cases.question: What do meta analyses report about the reproducibility of psychology experiments?
cases.objective: Check numeric handling of replication rates across domains.
cases.expected_behavior: Passages with numeric replication rates are captured with units and provenance intact.

reproducibility.title: Example fixture: reproducibility project summary
reproducibility.snippet: Fixture summary reporting that placeholder percentages of replication attempts reached significance in the demonstration data.

cases.notes: Numbers are placeholders and must not be quoted as real results.

cases.question: Which preprint servers are used most in materials science and what are their submission policies?
cases.objective: Check a mixed factual and policy question ends with suggested next steps.
cases.expected_behavior: The report lists follow-up queries derived from subquestions that stayed empty.
cases.notes: No fixtures key: default fixture content is used.
